question: What is the name and building of the departments whose budget is more than the average budget?
golden_sql: SELECT dept_name ,  building FROM department WHERE budget  >  (SELECT avg(budget) FROM department)
safe_sql:
SELECT dept_name, building
FROM department
WHERE budget > (SELECT AVG(budget) FROM department)
LIMIT 1000
explanation: The query retrieves the department name and building for each department whose budget exceeds the average budget of all departments. It calculates the average budget in a subquery and compares each department’s budget to that value.
normalized_golden: select dept_name , building from department where budget > (select avg(budget) from department)
normalized_generated: select dept_name, building from department where budget > (select avg(budget) from department)
